_source: READ-ONLY capture of live sim_run fd6ed035-9341-417e-8266-11055f6a86e6 (scenario busy_day, twin depot 11111111-..., speed_x 3 on all 1,578 ticks, playback live): the run the founder watched on 2026-10-06, 18:50:55Z..20:47:52Z (1:50-3:47 PM CT), reporting cars that spin in place near other cars and in jams. From public.vehicle_state_log, filtered on depot_id and created_at (the table has no sim_run_id column): 1,380 rows, less the 116 'offline' rows the stop wrote at 20:47:52Z (the cockpit clears the scene on the run's terminal status; it does not drive the fleet out), = 1,264 transitions for 116 cars. The final state per vehicle per instant: 566 frames, 1,012 changes (211 same-instant chains, resolved by previous_state; none cyclic). Each frame is visible at its rows' created_at (wall_ms since the run started); the sim clock is interpolated between tick commits from public.ottoq_tick_clock_log (real_ended_at, sim_clock_after), anchored at started_at = sim_clock_start. THE WHOLE RUN is kept (the file is small); the replay tests take windows of it by maxWallMs, from the start, so every window opens on the run's own first frame. Stalls as ottoq_twin_depot_layout serves them on 2026-10-07 (charger rows at the 60-degree pitch, after migration 0561); roster soc is vehicles.current_soc at capture. Exports verified by md5 against the database. No writes were made to the database by the capture.
